name: c12f-check
description: Step C12f books check: 360 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, hot vents and a mineral spring, the sea switched on at runtime, N (60 s), 40 cells placed with the add-cell tool (80 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s) and back (210 s), the hot vent off and on, its heat and the sea's knobs up and back, the sea off and on, G, a snapshot saved and loaded at once (300 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.3, 'heavy', 300); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.7, v.cssH * 0.7, 'heavy', 300, {rate: 30}); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'light', 300); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 40}, (_, k) => [150 + 13 * k, 120]), moire.genome.founders[0])
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'heavy', 300); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 300); return 'springs again'
moire.vents.params.hot = false; return 'vent as in C12d'
moire.vents.params.hot = true; moire.vents.params.heat = 40; moire.vents.params.seaRate = 0.1; moire.vents.params.seaLevel = 2; return 'hot, knobs up'
moire.vents.params.sea = true; moire.vents.params.seaRate = 0.02; moire.vents.params.seaLevel = 0.5; return 'sea on, knobs back'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
